I've marked shell as done in `plan.md` but still need to tick items 1, 8, 17, and 25 in `elements.md`, and should note `quoinPair` as an unused import since quoins ended up using plain quartz cells instead.

input.summary: Shell built: brick walls with deepslate plinth for main body and wing, quartz lintels, quoins, string courses and eaves bands, floors at y13/18/23 with stair wells and loft hatch, interior partitions and aisle partitions. Openings are left as air. make.sh produces a whole build.nbt, with no refused writes.
left: Window sills (quartz slabs) and shutters are for the glazing part
Interior door leaves and glass are for the joinery part
elements.md items not ticked by me

waste.what: Hand-listed opening and lintel coordinates for ~40 windows and doors, partitions and floor rectangles with wells
waste.cost: about 100 coordinate tuples worked out by hand in one script
waste.tool: A plan-driven helper: opening(table row) that carves air, adds the lintel and sill, and a floorWithHoles(box, holes) helper

waste.what: Quoins hand-placed because quoinPair writes air-only and the walls were already built
waste.cost: one workaround: trim cells were left as holes in the wall and filled afterwards

companions.task: Quoin rhythm and lintel/sill detailing on every opening, plus mossy or cracked brick variation near the plinth
Floor joists and stair wells at y13/18/23 with exact trimmer cuts
